checks: Rule routing for add, complete, agenda, free-time, task, plan and notes phrasings with no model call; questions never become writes; model routes are reduced to allowed tools and fields
Proposals write nothing; wrong or missing hashes are refused; edits issue a new hash that voids the old approval; approval executes exactly once
Receipts survive a restart, a reopened store refuses duplicate execution, and undo removes the added task once
Rejected and expired proposals execute nothing
An interrupted execution is reported as unknown after restart and is never retried automatically
Completing a task needs one unambiguous match, refuses a task edited after review, and undo reopens it
Agenda and free-time tools use only the imported snapshot, mark finished/upcoming events, ignore all-day events for availability, flag tentative, stale and uncovered data
Notes tool returns cited passages as data; instructions inside a note cannot create a proposal
Generated answers that echo the data block, cite times or time ranges absent from it (such as calling a partly booked period free), or claim a change are replaced with the deterministic summary
